variants.headline: Still in view: shipbuilding for the colony route
variants.sub: Shipbuilding by the home world has provided a larger vessel or another vessel for the colony route.
variants.body:
The home world has built a larger ship or an additional ship for the colony route. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Ships matter to working people because a distant connection is part of the colony's common life. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
